protocol.candidate_policy: Enumerate unary method chains by length; primitive order is shuffled once per case, learned methods append to the same registry. All candidates are evaluated by the corresponding native backend. Stop a stage at its first training solution.
protocol.admission: Wrap the successful graph with native EvolvedMethod or OpFromGraph and append it to the method registry after stages 1 and 2. No verification feedback affects admission.
protocol.capacity: Both primitive-only and growing libraries can express all targets within four top-level and eight expanded calls. This study uses growing libraries to exercise the integration path, not to claim a search improvement over a fixed library.
protocol.data: 17 dyadic training values and 32 disjoint verification values; no task-role type labels.
protocol.purpose: Workflow/API coverage. Twelve method-order permutations are coverage cases, not a task-level statistical sample or a state-of-the-art synthesis benchmark.
protocol.primary_execution: Pure numerical scalar programs. Object/vector/action interface boundaries are separate native-API probes.
